prompt: 72-hour revenue sprint, task 1. Audit the existing canonical revenue systems before coding: Revenue Pulse, Buyer Acquisition, Revenue CRM, Opportunity Radar/Factory, first-revenue readiness, commercial terms/exchange, Founder Console and any existing revenue-command or next-action logic. REUSE or ENHANCE existing canonical modules; do not create a shadow CRM, shadow revenue ledger, shadow buyer store or duplicate opportunity engine. Implement the smallest production-quality Revenue Command Queue that answers from real evidence: who/what can move toward revenue now, what offer/product is relevant when known, the next reversible internal action, the exact blocker, evidence refs, and current commercial state. Unknown remains unknown. A forecast, score, proposal, send, payment request or unverified payment is not revenue. Surface the queue read-only in Founder Console if the existing architecture supports it cleanly. Add a concise docs/REVENUE_SPRINT_72H.md describing the 72-hour sequence and the founder gates. Add focused tests. Do not enable live outbound, send email/SMS/voice, issue payment requests, move funds, apply database migrations, recognize revenue, alter RLS, or expand execution authority. Do not touch recovery/ or toop/.
